{{Quote|We got to the mess at the same time, got our grub, and sat down together.|Sketch supports Punch's alibi|audio=SketchAlibi-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
'''Sketch''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was dispatched with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led contingent of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Sketch joined his [[Platoon/Legends|unit]] on reconnoitering the planet for a strategical ambush site, but the Confederacy was able to [[Ground warfare/Legends|ambush]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces. After the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] returned to [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|base]], Sketch and fellow [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Punch/Legends|Punch]] went to the mess hall. When [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] interrogated the members of Slick's platoon to locate a possible Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]], Sketch vouched for [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] [[Jester/Legends|Jester]], and Punch and Sketch served as each other's alibis. Trooper [[Chopper (clone trooper)/Legends|Chopper]] claimed to have immediately gone to the mess hall, but Sketch objected and stated that he had come in later. However, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick himself was later revealed to be the turncoat and was apprehended.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Anyone else in the mess able to confirm what you two are saying?''"<br />"''Lots of guys there. Ask any of them.''"<br />"''Oh, we will.|Rex interrogates Sketch|audio=AskAnyOfThem-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who took on the name Sketch<ref name="TCWCE" /> was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="DB clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he became a member of [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick's]] [[Slick's squad/Legends|unit]] of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].<ref name="Official Episode Guide: Season 1" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in the seventh [[Standard week/Legends|week]] of the war,<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref><ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Sketch was dispatched with a contingent of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]]&mdash;under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

After their arrival on Christophsis, Slick's [[Platoon/Legends|unit]] reconnoitered the planet and located a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|double-towered business complex]] as a suitable site from which to ambush the Confederate [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. While returning to the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Republic base]], the platoon came across a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s that were attempting to clear a major boulevard of [[Christophsian/Legends|Christophsian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. When the battle droids found a crippled Christophsian and proposed [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, the clones intervened and eliminated the droids before returning to the base.<ref name="Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref>

[[File:Sketch_alibi.png|thumb|left|230px|Sketch and Punch served as each other's alibis.]]
Later, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Slick's platoon was stationed in the business building's south-facing tower with [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], while Skywalker and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were based with their [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the parallel north tower. The Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] prepared to attack the Confederate droids below, but the approaching droid column unexpectedly split in two, and battle droids arrived in the south tower and [[Ground warfare/Legends|ambushed]] the clones. Skywalker and his men arrived in the south tower to reinforce Kenobi's group, and after taking a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] to the roof of the tower, the Republic forces escaped in [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]].<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

After the Republic forces had returned to their base, Sketch and fellow platoon member [[Punch/Legends|Punch]] went to the mess hall,<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> which they habitually frequented.<ref name="TCWCE" /> During investigations regarding the possibility of a Confederate [[Spy/Legends|spy]] amongst their ranks, Cody and Rex traced an irregular wavelength in external communications to Slick's [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]]. Suspecting that one of the sergeant's men was the enemy agent, the two clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] called the platoon back to its quarters to individually interrogate its members. Sketch vouched for the nervous [[Jester/Legends|Jester]] and verified his alibi, and Sketch and Punch supported each other's claims that they had been in the mess hall. When trooper [[Chopper (clone trooper)/Legends|Chopper]] stated he had also been in the mess hall with them, Sketch refuted his claim. With encouragement from Cody, Sketch revealed that Chopper had not arrived to the mess hall until later in the evening. However, Slick was eventually revealed to be the spy, and escaped before severely damaging the Republic's [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]], and weapons depot. When Slick was spotted running into the base's command center, and Rex and Cody ordered Slick's platoon to secure the perimeter. The two clone officers later managed to apprehend Slick.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Dialogue|Chopper|I was in the mess hall.|Sketch|No you weren't! I mean, you&hellip;|Cody|If you know something, kid, you should ''speak up''.|Sketch|Chopper came in&hellip;a lot later, after everyone else.|attr=Sketch challenges Chopper's alibi|audio=AfterEveryoneElse-THE.flac|src=<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
[[File:Slickssquad.png|thumb|right|250px|Sketch and his brethren discover Slick's treachery.]]
A Human [[Gender/Legends|male]], Sketch had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin, black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="TCWCE" /> He had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Senth/Legends|Senth]], or "S," above his left eye.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> During the Battle of Christophsis, he frequented the Republic base's mess hall with fellow trooper Punch to the point where it became a habit.<ref name="TCWCE" /> In the course of investigations into a possible traitor within his unit, Sketch verified Jester's claim and noted his fellow trooper's "obsession" for always cleaning his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] after every battle.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> His keen observation skills helped Cody and Rex eliminate suspects and zero in on the real traitor.<ref name="TCWCE" /> When Chopper claimed to be in the mess hall, Sketch objected to his statement but then stopped, only continuing with persuasion from Cody. Sketch was later shocked when his own sergeant, Slick, was revealed to be the turncoat.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> He was trained for combat, and his [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|clone armor's]] greaves were dingy with grime from fighting.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sketch first appeared in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Shadowed|''Shadowed'']],<ref name="Shadowed" /> and went on to appear in "[[The Hidden Enemy]]," the episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]]' [[2008]]&ndash;[[2009]] [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] into which the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] led. In the episode, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who provided the voice for all of the series' clone trooper characters.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy Ep Guide" /> Sketch's model was later reused for clone trooper [[Edge/Legends|Edge]] in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Brain Invaders]]."<ref name="Brain Invaders Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode208.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Brain Invaders}}</ref>
